name: Apis Cor Frank
summary: Mobile 3D concrete printer from Florida that stands inside the building footprint, prints walls of houses up to two storeys and is moved around the site without cranes; works with the Gary material unit.

germany.statusNote: Apis Cor offers its systems to US homebuilders ('Bring automated construction to your job sites') and builds homes itself; no price, German or EU route or CE information found.

specs.label: Building height
specs.quote: capable of printing buildings up to two stories tall with no on-site assembly

specs.label: Relocation on site
specs.conditions: no cranes, pallet jacks or large crews
specs.quote: Relocating Frank around the job site takes less than 25 minutes

specs.label: Setup before printing
specs.quote: Ready to print in under 30 minutes.

specs.label: Transport
specs.value: pickup truck and trailer (Frank and Gary)
specs.quote: Frank and Gary can be transported with a pickup truck and trailer

specs.label: System units
specs.value: Gary (mobile mixing with self-learning material control), Mary (material delivery)
specs.quote: Compact and mobile, Gary moves easily with Frank across job sites

notes: Stands on the slab inside the building and leaves through the door opening when the walls are done.
Reinforcement is placed and grouted in the printed walls as in CMU block construction.
